title: 远瀛观 Yuanying Guan
subtitle: Yuan Ying Kuan, View of Distant Seas · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: terrace (OSM ruin polygon, S03): 59.2 × 51 m, eave 2 m, ridge 2 m
three-storey centre, double-eave hip roof (S109): 21 × 18 m, eave 12 m, ridge 15 m

facts.value: Yuan Ying Kuan, View of Distant Seas

facts.label: Built
facts.value: 乾隆四十八年 1783 (S42 12613; printed there as 乾隆十四八年)

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: Looted and burnt 1860; stone ruins stayed, further damage 1900 and after (S02 pp.142,218)

facts.label: Bays
facts.value: 5 (S06) in the texts / 5x4 on the plan

facts.label: Tiles
facts.value: 五色琉璃, 鱼鳞金瓦 (S06)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Copper engraving no. 14 per S02. Later than 大水法 (S42). Excavated 2016: 3 phases, late-Qing use (S42). Gobelins tapestries 1767 (S02 p.160); S06 says Louis XVI. Grey brick with carved marble (S02 p.155).
